messages:
Amina (on-call): hey team, quick heads-up — i'm at the airport, gate delay. i won't have reliable laptop access for ~2.5-3h. i'm the primary for the 2am->10am window. can we swap primary to Ravi for the next ~3 hours? i can stay reachable by phone for escalation.

Ravi K: i can take primary. grabbing the pager now. ping me any active incidents i should look at. do i have access for the private deploy keys/HSM currently?

PagerBot: [ALERT] INCIDENT private-deploy/kms-rotation FAILURE detected
Severity: P2
Triggered: 1778881200
Summary: repeated HSM unwrap timeouts while rotating customer keys in us-west-2. Current on-call primary: Amina (on-call). Paging triggered.

Amina (on-call): thanks @Ravi K — there's that KMS churn alert going on. Sam, you're secondary — can you shadow Ravi until i get back? i left notes in the runbook with the current suspect: KMS proxy flapping on node-3.

Sam T: got it. i'll shadow and hold the secondary pager. Ravi, if you need escalation to Lena (infra lead) i can ping.

Ravi K: ok i'm set. i've accepted the pager handoff in PagerDuty. i'll start by checking pod health + unwrap latencies. paste runbook link pls.

Amina (on-call): runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kms-rotation — see the "quick triage" section. key commands: 
```
# check pods and logs
kubectl -n private get pods -l app=kms-proxy -o wide
kubectl -n private logs deploy/kms-proxy --since=15m | grep -i unwrap
# proxy node check
ssh jump@ops-host 'sudo journalctl -u kms-proxy -n 200'
# temporarily route to standby KMS (if needed)
kubectl -n private patch svc kms-proxy -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"tier":"standby"}}}'
```

Ravi K: perfect. running those now. first glance: pod kms-proxy-3 is in CrashLoopBackOff, others show higher latency traces. i'll try to restart the pod and confirm HSM connectivity.

Lena M: if restarting pod, please keep an eye on token unwrapping error rates. we had a config drift last week where the HSM client cert rotated and one node kept the old bundle. if restart doesn't stabilize, i'll coordinate a cert redeploy.

Ravi K: restarting kms-proxy-3 now (kubectl rollout restart deploy/kms-proxy). will monitor.

PagerBot: ACTION REQUIRED — handoff in progress: primary changed from Amina (on-call) -> Ravi K at 1778881305 per PagerDuty acceptance. Secondary remains Sam T.

Sam T: i'm monitoring logs and ready to take over if Ravi needs to step out. noticing a spike in unwrap-timeouts from 1778881180..1778881280 in the metrics.

Ravi K: restart did a soft recover; pod came back but unwrap latencies still spiking ~300-600ms. i'm going to switch a subset of traffic to standby KMS and throttle batch rotations. doing: 
```
kubectl -n private scale deploy/kms-proxy --replicas=4
kubectl -n private patch svc kms-proxy -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"tier":"standby"}}}' --dry-run=client -o yaml
```

Amina (on-call): thanks @Ravi K and @Sam T — appreciate the quick handoff. i'm going to mark myself as "reachable by phone" in the schedule and will update when i'm back online. :thumbsup:

Lena M: i can be on call for infra escalation if you need cert rotation. ping me on slack or call.

Ravi K: switching traffic completed, unwrap error rate dropped to baseline over the last 5m. i'll keep primary for the remaining window unless anyone objects.

Sam T: no objections, coverage looks good. i'll keep monitoring and will take over if anything regresses.

PagerBot: NOTE — incident private-deploy/kms-rotation acknowledged by Ravi K at 1778881320. Current status: mitigated (traffic rerouted) — monitoring.

Amina (on-call): confirmed — thanks all. i'll log the handoff in the rotation doc and update the oncall notes with the duration of my offline time.

Ravi K: logging notes now: "temporary primary swap 1778881305->1778884320 due to travel delay. mitigations: restarted kms-proxy pod, rerouted to standby KMS, lowered rotation batch size. contact Lena for cert roll if unwrap errors return."

Sam T: added a quick post-incident checklist to the runbook with the commands we used.

Amina (on-call): back online at gate, wifi spotty but i'm checking in. thanks for covering. :bow:

PagerBot: THREAD CLOSED — handoff ended at 1778884320 per manual closure by Ravi K.
